summary: Ruled on the central design question: option (a) as literally stated (a PreToolUse hook on the Write|Edit tool matcher) cannot see most specs/state.json task-creation writes, since they occur via Bash-invoked scripts/jq, not the Write/Edit tool. Resolved as a two-layer design: per-surface audit invocation at the SKILL layer (not the agent layer, per task 300's AskUserQuestion-rehome precedent) feeding an enforcement gate anchored at scripts/state-write.sh (the already-adopted mutex-guarded writer), backstopped by a Bash-matcher structural hook at hooks/validate-task-creation-audit.sh. All nine dependency tasks named in the dispatch's original cost calculus, plus this task's own four dependencies, are now completed/abandoned, so the decision rests on uniformity-vs-blocking-depth grounds alone. Also grounded deliverable 2's open+closed backlog union, deliverable 3's recall-biased keyword-shortlist design (no similarity utility exists to reuse), and the dual call-shape (task 421) requirement.

artifacts.summary: Rules on the state-write-boundary-hook vs per-surface-wiring question, finds the Write|Edit hook premise false given the actual heterogeneous state.json write path, proposes a two-layer enforcement design anchored at scripts/state-write.sh, and grounds the closed-records widening and semantic-pass design.

memory_candidates.content: In this codebase, specs/state.json's write path is heterogeneous across creation surfaces: some call scripts/state-write.sh (the mutex-guarded writer) via Bash, others (agents/meta-builder-agent.md, skills/skill-fix-it/SKILL.md) mutate it via raw jq/Bash calls that bypass state-write.sh entirely. A Claude-Code PreToolUse hook matched on the Write|Edit tool never sees any of these, because the mutation happens inside a Bash tool invocation, not a Write/Edit tool call. Any future write-time enforcement on specs/state.json must anchor at scripts/state-write.sh itself (extending its transform->validate pipeline) or use a Bash-matcher hook inspecting command text, never a Write|Edit-matcher content scanner.

AskUserQuestion is categorically unreachable from a dispatched subagent in this harness (measured by task 300). The fix pattern is to rehome any interactive gate into the calling skill's own pre-delegation stage (e.g. skill-meta Stage 2.5), never inside the agent. multi-task-creation-standard.md Component 7 documents this as a standing 'Foreground Requirement.' Any new component needing human disposition on an ambiguous verdict should render into an existing foreground confirmation step rather than inventing a new AskUserQuestion call inside a dispatched agent.

No title/description similarity (jaccard/cosine/levenshtein/fuzzy) utility exists anywhere in agent-system/extensions/core/scripts/ as of this check. script-inventory.sh's exact-duplicate-block detector is for code refactoring and explicitly disclaims fuzzy near-duplicate matching as future/out-of-scope. A future task needing semantic/title similarity for task dedup starts from nothing and should prefer a cheap, recall-biased keyword/token-overlap shortlist consumed by the LLM-in-the-loop caller, not a fully automated verdict.
